sentences.text:
Abhijit Ray @ Avijit Roy And Others vs The State Of West
Bengal And Another on 15 April, 2024

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 D/L149 C.R.R.1415 of 2024
15.04.2024
Bpg.

Abhijit Ray @ Avijit Roy and others Versus The State of West Bengal and another Mr. Brotindra
Mullick Mr. Debnath Ganguly Mr. Supriyo Dutta Mr. Chiranjit Pal.

Petitioners are directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party no.1/State through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon the opposite party no.2 by speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date fixed for hearing.

I find that the charge-sheet in the present case has been submitted under Sections 498A/323/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and none of the witnesses who have been cited as prosecution witness is a lady.
Learned advocate for the petitioners submits that they are unable to obtain the documents under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, as some of the accused persons have not participated in the proceedings.
Learned ACJM, Barrackpore is directed to supply the copies under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to the petitioner or the accused persons who will be present before the court.
Having regard to the subject matter of the present litigation, I am of the view that the revisional application is required to be heard out on merits.
Matter be listed under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of August, 2024.
Pending hearing of the revisional application, further proceedings of Baranagar Police Station Case No.399 dated 01.08.2021 before the learned ACJM, Barrackpore be stayed till 31st August, 2024.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
